$comment: Severity-tiering config — SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for /np, /nightwork-init-phase, /nightwork-plan-review, /nightwork-qa, /nx. Derived from .planning/process/PLANNING-PIPELINE-TIERING.md (APPROVED Rev 3, commit 462e2a3); implemented per tiering-implementation phase (nwrp285). PA-2 condition: this file is COMMITTED, never gitignored — rigor parameters change only via reviewable commits. REVIEW-N tuning lands as diffs to this file.

LOW.smoke: anon-tolerant; authed REQUIRED for non-PUBLIC paths; Owner Portal critical

MEDIUM.conditional_rule: pick the dominant axis; if genuinely 2 apply, surface at /np dispatch and add the second
MEDIUM.smoke: authed primitive REQUIRED for UI surfaces; anon OK for PUBLIC-path gates

pipeline.planner_iters: 1 default; iter-2 ONLY on iter-1 findings (Rev 2 — no forced re-author)

plan_review_reviewers_base6: <ONE-of architect|enterprise-readiness (signal table; both fire = BOTH, base 7)>
HIGH.smoke: SmokeAuthHelper REQUIRED; financial phases run ai-logic-tester against Drummond fixtures e2e

architect_vs_enterprise_signals.$comment: HIGH base-6 'ONE of' picked mechanically (design §2.3). Both-fire => BOTH (base 7). Zero-fire on a HIGH phase => init mis-tier, halt for re-tier per §6.2.
enterprise_readiness: error handling / graceful degradation in plan body

init_detection_signals.$comment: Informational hints at /nightwork-init-phase — NOT auto-tier. Rendered IN the severity_rationale per nwrp285 PA-1 condition: the rationale must name the SIGNALS, not just the verdict.

retier_triggers.$comment: §6.2 mechanical halt-and-re-tier. Fire at plan-author, plan-review iter-1, or QA time. Executor HALTS — never auto-re-tiers. Every firing appends to mid_execute_halts.jsonl (PA-3).

triggers.condition: schema change (migrations in files_modified OR CREATE/ALTER TABLE / CREATE POLICY in plan body)
cross-tenant concern (platform_admins rows, impersonation, cross-org joins, RLS posture)
financial logic / cents math (financial-entity status transitions, new aggregation, payment math, G702/G703 logic)
triggers.action: HALT → re-tier MEDIUM minimum (HIGH if also schema/cross-tenant)

triggers.condition: cross-tenant data flow (cross-org joins, new platform-admin surface, new RLS)
reviewer flags tier-mismatch at plan-review iter-1

triggers.action: HALT → re-tier to discovered tier; work-done = precursor for retroactive review

friction_tax.metric: mid_execute_halt_rate(tier) = §6.2 halts / phases dispatched, trailing 4 per tier
friction_tax.capture_contract: APPEND-ONLY and COMMITTED (nwrp285 PA-3). One JSON object per halt event: {when, phase, tier_at_dispatch, trigger, recommended_tier, disposition, synthetic}. PIPELINE-TIERING-REVIEW-N.md MUST cite this file as its data source; an EMPTY file at REVIEW-1 is itself a finding — distinguish nothing-halted from nothing-logged.
friction_tax.breach_action: next PIPELINE-TIERING-REVIEW-N.md MUST propose revisions (tier characteristics OR signal regex set), Jake-authorized, shipped BEFORE the next phase at that tier dispatches
